interpretation: Column headings carry column meanings as source context; bag ordinals and weight headings also delimit applicability. No headings or proper legal conditions are deleted, guessed true, or counted as covered by this audit. The current model/interface must still supply a faithful executable mapping. Scalar inputs and arithmetic nodes do not constitute typed B connector inputs. This distinguishes representation burden from actual model errors, without claiming all failures are a model capability limit.
